representation: phones-tier interval raw triplet sil,<observed_phone>,a; resolved relation addition; expected canonical placeholder <SIL>; observed canonical is the added phone
expected_phone_identity_present: placeholder sil/<SIL>, not a canonical expected phone

clean_rule.support_count_rule: A clean addition event is one frozen V4 row whose resolved relation field equals addition. The V4 parser has already enforced expected raw placeholder sil and a canonical observed phone.

required_fields_for_train_validation_det.observed_phone_canonical: one of the frozen 40 canonical phones

clean_rule.test_rule: For TEST, inspect only speaker_id and frozen relation to count aggregate clean additions and per-speaker support; no detailed fields, identities, sequences, phones, positions, paths, or examples are inspected or exported.
clean_rule.mixed_error_policy: A clean addition event remains eligible when another clean relation occurs in the same word; mixed status is reported and never used for exclusion.
clean_rule.multiple_addition_policy: Each clean addition interval is one event; all events are retained. Words are separately classified as single-addition or multiple-addition.
exclusions: tagged addition whose resolved relation is unresolved
addition with expected raw token other than sil
unknown, malformed, noncanonical, or non-speech observed phone
non-finite or non-positive interval for detailed TRAIN/VALIDATION event analysis
ambiguous or missing manual-word containment for word/position/CTC analyses only
clean_rule.exclusion_reporting: All excluded or ambiguous tagged additions are counted by reason; support gates use resolved clean addition relation events and are never redefined after counts are seen.

position_contract.boundary_definition: For an addition row in a word with expected sequence length N, boundary equals the number of expected-sequence rows preceding that addition in source interval order.
position_contract.ambiguous_position_policy: If unique word containment or a nonempty expected sequence cannot be established, retain the clean event in source-level support but report position as ambiguous and exclude it only from position/exact-event metrics.
